The '''''Tinoon Sec''''' was a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 gunship]] that was part of [[Tinoon Station]]'s security forces. It was destroyed during a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raid, that was successfully driven off by [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]].
